cases.text: The harbor opens early. Small fishing boats cross the water while workers unload baskets beside the old stone pier.
To plant a bean, place it in damp soil near a sunny window. Water gently and watch for the first green leaves.
The museum has a blue door and a wide staircase. Inside, visitors can explore paintings, maps, and models of ancient ships.
A bicycle bell helps warn people on a shared path. Slow down near corners and leave enough space when passing.
The train leaves from platform seven. Keep your ticket nearby and check the destination before stepping into the carriage.
On a clear evening, the moon can appear above the eastern hills. Its bright surface reflects sunlight toward the Earth.

raw_levels: Retain each capture, raw MIC1 whole/pre/post RMS; no threshold or retake.
stop_rule: At most 6 replies, stop issuing replies at first device receive/dispatch delta less than recorder outgoing RTVI count, or other admission failure. Export evidence and restore. Zero recorder output or unhealthy SCTP tap is diagnostic failure.

readout.1b: DATA sent, T3/retransmissions, SACK cumulative TSN stuck below retransmitted TSN: device not acknowledging; distinguish loss on the return path if not observable.
readout.1a: SACK advances past undelivered messages, device receive delta short: SCTP acknowledges but does not deliver to application.
readout.2: No DATA while bufferedAmount grows, or outbound_queue grows with flight below cwnd: host send side.

repeat: Only if first hold completes without reproduction: one fresh declared hold with metrics_enabled=True evaluation-only source copy; no default change.
cleanup: flock for all board/Jabra operations; restore/hash verify normal 9936da45, mixer byte-equal, stop owned bot, release lock; retain lock if restoration fails
